scope: Read-only file integrity, executable entry points, save transaction and recovery source review of the actual uploaded Round 13 baseline. No remote or browser operations.
runtimeFindings: Package has no dependencies, install hooks, or external runtime fetch calls in src/index; start/test/check use supplied local Node scripts.
The HTTP server binds only 127.0.0.1 and allowlists shipping HTML, SVG, JS, CSS, WebP and WOFF2 routes. HTTP smoke actually confirmed 52 resource byte matches and metadata/test route rejection.

The Windows launcher changes to its own directory and invokes the supplied launch module. The module probes only loopback, verifies release metadata, and on Windows opens that fixed URL. Windows execution itself was not tested.

No executable binary payload, package manager lockfile, .npmrc or .env was found in the uploaded file inventory. Test/audit VM and child-process uses correspond to local supplied-source QA, syntax checks, and loopback serve smoke.
saveFindings: Current schema remains 5 and original save/mirror/legacy/settings keys are unchanged.

saveGame validates the full current expected snapshot before full new-state encoding, retains legacy-archive checks and ordering, writes the primary before mirror, and surfaces primary/mirror failure distinctly.
decodeStoredSave validates a newly parsed full object; current-schema reads have no retained cross-operation object cache. Migrations deep-clone before legacy additions.
Full state and unknown nested JSON fields remain in encodeSave and expected comparison. Opening/buying reward ownership was previously isolated with structuredClone.
Recovery restoration rechecks both original strings under the app write lock, only accepts exact null/null, and retains normal save validation, full encoding, write limit and archive semantics.

App actions use the same Web Lock, reject changed in-memory expected states inside the lock, save before presentation, invalidate pending interactions during recovery, and require explicit candidate loading.
limitations: This is scoped source inspection and local automated verification, not an exhaustive security certification.
No real Windows execution, physical device/browser quotas, operating-system failure or power-loss claim.
LocalStorage is not universal atomic compare-and-set against external writers ignoring the shared Web Lock.
The original 5,000,000 byte/character save-write boundaries and unavailable historical font repair traces remain explicit.
The V5-era FILE_MANIFEST is historical and does not describe the current Round 13 files; only docs/iteration/FILE_MANIFEST is the current identity gate.
